GHSA-X9GQ-59M7-268R.b7d817c4b434c5559650175c8d676ed0d5ccc2a8:
fix: reject path traversal in chunk names from node_modules

Emit a build error when a webpackChunkName magic comment or
require.ensure chunk name from a node_modules dependency contains
"..", preventing supply-chain path traversal writes outside
output.path (GHSA-x9gq-59m7-268r).

User-authored code is not affected — the check only applies to
modules resolved under node_modules.
